name: Tetrachloroethylene, at plant
pdf: 2007 - LCI chemicals - Althaus.pdf
note: Chapter 24 'Chloromethanes and Tetrachloroethylene' of the cited `2007 - LCI chemicals - Althaus.pdf` is this dataset's chapter. Its two inventory tables, Tab. 24.2 (p.301) and Tab. 24.3 (p.302), are captioned 'In- / Outputs for the modules "methyl chloride, at plant", "dichloromethane, at plant", "trichloroethylene, at plant" ...' but they hold the cumulated Boustead vectors of those datasets - resources, emissions and waste-treatment services, no production input - i.e. the targets' own answers, which the ecoSpold comment of this dataset states as well ('The data source for this process is a system inventory from Boustead. Due to the cumulated form of this data only the ressources and emissions included in the data source were considered'). For tetrachloroethylene sec. 24.8.1 gives the joint TRI/PER equation 'C2H4 + C2H4Cl2 + 2.5 Cl2 + 1.75 O2 -> C2HCl3 + C2Cl4 + 3.5 H2O' - a reaction that produces trichloroethylene and tetrachloroethylene together - and the alternative CTC/PER chlorinolysis route, with no split between them and, per sec. 24.7.2, no allocation between the two products. One equation cannot be solved for one of two co-products without an allocation the report says it does not have. Per the rule that the cited report is not the only report that may document a dataset, all 114 bundled reports were converted with pdftotext and searched for an inventory of this dataset. No other bundled report models tetrachloroethylene production.

Per the rule that the cited report is not the only report that may document a dataset, all 114 bundled reports were converted with pdftotext and searched for an inventory of this dataset.
